decisions.reason: Conferencing is commoditised and under heavy pressure from Teams and Zoom since the pandemic, but it still complements the voice portfolio and existing contracts, so it is likely kept another year despite rising withdrawal risk.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm's fibre and carrier-neutral data centre strategy and has proven adoption in financial hubs.
A self-service number ordering portal fits the shift toward real-time, software-defined provisioning and costs little to run, though it could be folded into a broader portal.

Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service as PSTN moves to all-IP, but it still earns revenue from a residual customer base and will likely be wound down gradually rather than dropped abruptly.
Direct voice network connections stay relevant for enterprises and service providers migrating to SIP and cloud voice.
